precepts.text: Man that is born of a woman is of few days and full of trouble; he cometh forth like a flower and is cut down, he fleeth also as a shadow and continueth not.
precepts.point: All praises that Elijah was there to call upon the Lord, for it was not the young man's time to go. A man's days are determined and appointed, and he cannot pass the bound the Most High has set; because it was not the child's time, the Lord let his soul return.

note.label: 1 Kings 17: The Word of the Lord in Elijah's Mouth Is Truth

precepts.why:
“Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble. He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.”

The widow’s son fell sick, “and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.” A man’s life is short and full of trouble, and it can be cut down like a flower. The widow took it that the child was paying for her sins: “art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?”

But how long a man lives is not his own to decide, nor the grieving mother’s. That rests with the Most High, as the verses that follow show.

precepts.text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee; thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass. When the appointed day comes a man cannot pass it, but this child's day had not yet come.
precepts.point: All praises that Elijah was there to call upon the Lord, for it was not the young man's time to go. A man's days are determined and appointed, and he cannot pass the bound the Most High has set; because it was not the child's time, the Lord let his soul return.

note.label: 1 Kings 17: The Word of the Lord in Elijah's Mouth Is Truth

precepts.why:
“Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass”. A man’s days are determined and appointed. When the appointed day comes, a man cannot pass it.

But this child’s day had not yet come. Elijah carried him up into the loft, laid him on his own bed, stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried, “O Lord my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again. And the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.” Because it was not the child’s time, the Lord let his soul return.

All praises that Elijah was there to call upon the Lord. And the widow said, “Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in thy mouth is truth.”

precepts.text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one, which speaks of the animals, while Israel as a planted holy seed can be cleansed.
precepts.point: The northern kingdom was planted a holy and righteous seed, so it can be cleansed again, unlike the unclean animals that were made unclean from the beginning. The Most High promised to save Israel out of all their dwelling places where they had sinned and to cleanse them.

note.label: Acts 10: Cornelius and the Northern Kingdom Grafted In

precepts.why:
“Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.”

That speaks of the animals. The unclean animals were made unclean from the beginning, and no prayer makes them clean. But the northern kingdom was planted a holy and righteous seed, so it can be cleansed again. That is why the Most High can say, “What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common”: he is speaking of Israel, not of swine.

points: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass. Our days on this earth are determined; there is a day and an hour that every one of us has to die, already ordained by God, and we cannot pass that bound. Though the scriptures show that if you fast and pray and really go in, the Lord can add years.

Till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day. A hireling is somebody you give work for a certain amount of time. God sends us on this earth with a job to do and a certain amount of time to do it, and once the job is finished and the time is up, he takes you back. The same with Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, David, Judah Maccabee and his brothers, Mattathias, Elijah: God has a purpose and a job for every one of us.

Turn from him, that he may rest: that rest is going back to paradise if you are righteous. For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again: our hope for immortality is that tree; a class for another day.
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
Santa Claus cannot be cleaned up by tracing him to a kind saint.
Man that is born of a woman is of few days and full of trouble. He comes forth like a flower and is cut down, fleeing as a shadow that does not continue.

note.label: Job 14: Man That Is Born Of A Woman

points: Job asks who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean, answering: not one. A man's days are determined and his months numbered, his bounds appointed by God that he cannot pass.

note.label: Job 14: Man That Is Born Of A Woman

points: There is hope of a tree: if it be cut down it will sprout again through the scent of water, and its tender branch will not cease. But man dies and wastes away, gives up the ghost, and where is he.

note.label: Job 14: Man That Is Born Of A Woman

points: As the waters fail from the sea and the flood decays and dries up, so man lies down and rises not till the heavens be no more. He shall not awake nor be raised out of his sleep.

note.label: Job 14: Man That Is Born Of A Woman

points: Job wishes God would hide him in the grave and keep him secret until His wrath be past, appointing him a set time and then remembering him.

note.label: Job 14: Man That Is Born Of A Woman

points: He asks the question directly: if a man die, shall he live again. All the days of his appointed time he will wait till his change come. When God calls he will answer, for God will have a desire to the work of His hands.

note.label: Job 14: Man That Is Born Of A Woman

points: Job says God numbers his steps and watches over his sin, sealing his transgression up in a bag and sewing up his iniquity.

note.label: Job 14: Man That Is Born Of A Woman

points: As the mountain falling comes to nothing and the rock is removed and the waters wear the stones, so God destroys the hope of man. He prevails forever against him and sends him away, and the man does not even know when his sons come to honor or are brought low. His flesh upon him shall have pain and his soul within him shall mourn.
